summary: Instead of driving back along the coast: from Esperance through the Goldfields to Perth — ghost towns, 51 Gormley sculptures on a salt lake and outback pubs. Turns the southern leg into a real loop without doubling back. The Lake Ballard road is now fully sealed.

steps.desc: Super Pit Lookout, historic gold-rush town
“Inside Australia”: 51 Antony Gormley sculptures on the salt lake (only walk at sunrise/sunset, no shade!). Overnight at the Grand Hotel Kookynie or the free camp at Niagara Dam
Gwalia + Hoover House (note: closed on some days over Christmas/New Year — check beforehand), then back via the Great Eastern Hwy

summary: The proven coastal route, but with the station and beach camps from the insider notes instead of the packed tourist campgrounds. Leaves plenty of buffer for rest days in the 23-day window.

steps.desc: Lancelin dunes, the Pinnacles at sunset
Hutt Lagoon (pink lake), Kalbarri NP, night at Murchison Station
Monkey Mia early, Francois Peron day trip, camp at Herald Bight
Supplies, Space Museum
Maggies Camp, mantas, snorkelling
Turquoise Bay, Jurabi turtles, Yardie Creek
2 driving days (~1,250 km), stop e.g. in Geraldton

summary: The route hardly anyone does: the westernmost point of the continent, the barge to Dirk Hartog, the raw Quobba coast in turtle nesting season — and only then classic Ningaloo. Combines all your friend's insider spots with the Edel Land expedition goals.

steps.desc: Pinnacles, Kalbarri NP, Murchison Station — optional Abrolhos flight tour from Geraldton/Kalbarri
Shelter Bay (booked in advance!), Zuytdorp Cliffs, Thunder Bay — lower your tyre pressure
From Blackies Beach (book ahead, max. 20 vehicles on the island), 3 days self-sufficient
Francois Peron loop, Monkey Mia, camp at Herald Bight
Blowholes, Red Bluff, Gnaraloo (turtle nesting season!)
Maggies Camp, mantas
Crossing only at low tide, Turquoise Bay, Jurabi
The empty eastern side of Cape Range
2 long driving days, buffer on day 20

summary: For maximum remoteness: through the Gascoyne hinterland to the Kennedy Range and Mount Augustus, on to Karijini and the Millstream oasis — optionally as far as Carawine Gorge and Running Waters (the “Eel Pool” from the insider notes) in the East Pilbara. The most demanding plan in the document: in January only for very experienced, fully self-sufficient crews.

steps.desc: Kalbarri, Monkey Mia/Peron in short
Temple Gorge (booked online in advance!), Honeycomb Gorge at dusk
Loop drive, lookouts, Cattle Pool/Goolinee — the Summit Trail is CLOSED Nov–Feb (heat deaths)
Long gravel leg; get the (free) rail access road permit
Dales Gorge & Fern Pool, Weano/Handrail — early mornings only
Python Pool, Deep Reach Pool
Overnight on the way (e.g. Nanutarra)
Turquoise Bay, Jurabi, mantas
2 long driving days + buffer
Karijini → Marble Bar → Carawine Gorge → Running Waters/“Eel Pool” — the insider spot, borderline in high summer: road reports daily, 10+ L of water per person per day
